description: The rate limit middleware and key resolvers (rate-limiting contract sections 3 and 4). A route whose handler answers 200 {"ok":true} sits behind RateLimit.by(limiter, resolver); the limiter is the memory driver with the policy (limit, periodNanos, burst) and the clock set to each request's 'at'. resolver: literal (the key is the X-Test-Key header, null when absent), clientAddress, forwardedFor (trusted = n), header (name). cost, headers (RateLimit-* on), onStoreFailure (ALLOW | DENY), storeDown (the limiter throws RateLimitStoreException) and policyResolver (a resolver reads X-Test-Policy: 'null' -> no policy, 'throw' -> the resolver throws, 'unlimited' -> RateLimitPolicy.UNLIMITED, 'limit/periodMillis/burst' -> that policy) are the middleware's settings. A request is (at nanoseconds, remote address or null, headers as an ordered [name, value] list). expect per request: status; key = the key the limiter was asked about (null when it was not asked); headers = Retry-After and RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset when present; body = the response body as parsed JSON. A 429 is {error: RATE_LIMITED, message: 'too many requests'} with Retry-After in whole seconds rounded up and at least 1; RateLimit-Limit is the burst of the policy used, RateLimit-Reset the seconds until the bucket is full, rounded up. buildError: the resolver cannot be built (IllegalArgumentException). Keys are IP literals normalised as 'ip:<address>' for IPv4 (IPv4-mapped IPv6 included) and 'ip6:<first 8 bytes in hex>::/64' for IPv6, 'h:<sha256 hex>' for header(name); a key over 200 characters is 'sha256:<hex>'; a null or empty key is '-'. What counts as an IP literal is java.net.InetAddress.ofLiteral, which differs from other runtimes' parsers (zone ids, leading zeros, mapped addresses): each such case records Java's answer in 'javaLiteralCase' for the cases where a stricter parser may refuse; Go's netip is stricter and a recorded difference is expected there.
howToRun: Per case: build the limiter and middleware as described, send each request at its time with its remote address and headers, compare status, key, headers and body. Regenerate from Java with -Dconformance.update=true (RateLimitConformanceTest).
